title: Leeh aqayyaarek yewqeh yan tiya
intro: Dumaahi kitaabih annal, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak. Inki agat miraaciinol qibaadah miracsenta gorrisak giti tabaatabuk sooleh. maca fakkimte aqayyaare tonnal agiiranni too toh baxxaaqissam numma diini mara keenik fanat. Atu ta cuumi darrel raqteh tan rortittek baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu ummatta assakooteh tan samadak emeeteeh, Yalli yoo doorem oson edde rade waanam diini hadafah.
Yi dagar gersi mari kak salceh yan baxsih asta quukak sugeeh, yi ummattah fanat baxsa yoo soolisak suge.
Daqar aqayyaareh yeybeleeleqeh yan waqdi, mango mari wadirih yuduureh—takkay immay anu fooca fanah xukkuteh, Yallih xaganal diggalsimak suge.
Anu haram leek qigdu maaqube wayuh amriseh suge, takkay immay inki tiffa yi soktootak tewqeh—inni sorkocô baxat umman way taqabi le zambi.
Yalli yoh madqeh yan qunxa duuseenat angoorowem inki ayro caylale naqboyti qideemih aydaadu akkele.
Qande bood abte wak, anu naqboyti gabat rade hinnay, daqaaral abeh an ammirtimiyyah digaalah yallih amrit rade.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
